provenance: aggregate shape of 34 live v6 stores inspected 2026-10-27 (Linux) — key names/types only, no values captured

schema_version.note: store version marker, integer encoded as TEXT — selects this fixture

message_count.note: integer encoded as TEXT; equals the messages row count (see store_checks)

info.note: session metadata as a JSON-encoded string

info.title.note: absent on a minority of stores (present on 32/36 sampled v1+v6 stores)

truncated.note: boolean encoded as TEXT; present on 34/36 sampled v6 stores

janitor_managed.note: observed on 5/36 v6 stores (2026-10-27); value is an opaque token — vocabulary not enumerated; spec keeps the key space open

notes: The meta key space is open per spec — undeclared keys are tolerated and reported as extra_meta_keys, never contradictions.
